comments.comment: RE-SAN9PK-0112 [confirmed]: code 13 replaces the force strategist: old identity 2 becomes 3, selected identity 3 becomes 2, and force+0xC0 is updated. This command does not directly write salary or loyalty.
RE-SAN9PK-0112 [confirmed]: reward loyalty gain is min(50*(20-integrity)/100, 10), then capped by the remaining distance to 100.
RE-SAN9PK-0112 [confirmed]: each selected person receives the computed loyalty gain, costs 100 force funds, and gets person_flags 0x4000 until the next xun person update.
RE-SAN9PK-0112 [confirmed]: grant-item execution transfers holder ownership and adds item+0x40 to the recipient's loyalty through the common bounded feedback path.

RE-SAN9PK-0112 [confirmed]: exile sets non-prisoners' loyalty toward the expelling force to 45 before detaching them; prisoners instead gain floor(integrity/5) loyalty toward the captor and are released or re-homed.
RE-SAN9PK-0112 [confirmed]: recall groups selected people by current associated object and dispatches one transfer group per origin to a single destination.

RE-SAN9PK-0112 [confirmed]: move uses shared participant reservation, creates a command event and transfers people to the destination; moving a ruler across forces takes the dedicated force and unit migration branch.

RE-SAN9PK-0112 [confirmed]: each xun clears reward marker 0x4000 for every person; identity-4 prisoners make an affinity-distance-based probability check and gain 1 loyalty toward their current force on success.
RE-SAN9PK-0112 [confirmed]: writes one person's loyalty entry for the supplied force, or the current force when omitted.
RE-SAN9PK-0112 [confirmed]: removes an item from its old holder, assigns a valid new person holder when supplied, or clears holder state while preserving the item's location context.
